# 3 bed end of terrace house for sale

> Dee Gibney Properties are delighted to bring to the market this stunning end terraced house located in the sought-after Bolton Woods development in Callan, Co Kilkenny. Set on a corner plot with a unique external layout the property is presented in show home condition. It is evident from the internal design that the owners put a lot of thought into the finish of this property.

## Fakta
- Typ: end of terrace house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 103 m²
- Energetická náročnost: B
- Lokalita: 22 Roselawn, Bolton Woods, Callan
- Cena: 300 000 €
